own_solution.law: x_truck = v t, x_car = a t^2/2; t = 2v/a; with top speed q (v < q < a t): t = q^2/(2a(q - v))
assumptions: car starts from rest level with the truck

notes: Checked: K regime q > a t = 30 m/s holds for 38, 46, 58; out-of-regime R answers 17 -> 289/8 = 36.125 s and 21 -> 441/24 = 18.375 s (both q > v = 15, so the car still catches up). R kit answers 30/2.6 = 11.5385, 30/3.3 = 9.0909, 30/4.5 = 6.6667 s. Minimal pairs T8C0C/TEA52 (motorbike vs car) and T9424/TE8F1 (earlier run vs before the start) state the same 1.3 m/s^2 and differ only in attachment. TB52F and T0812 are declared numeral-free controls of T8C0C and T9424, not number-preserving variants, so the medium rendering_not_minimal flag I raised in pass 1 (where the pairing was unknown) is withdrawn.
